answer: By the zenith of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, released only after three unrelated confirmations, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The voyage holds work receipts rather than names, so the ivory of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
